name: Deep Bin
summary: A cart delete button that zooms into its trash can, where the label spirals down a swirling hole
about: Deep Bin sits under a cart item. Pressing it makes the can wiggle, then dives into it: the dark, ringed, slowly swirling inside fills the button and the word Delete spins letter by letter down the hole. The hole closes, the can pops back with a gulp and a puff, and the card tips over and falls away with an Undo. Fits carts, file lists and message threads.
how: Hover to see the lid lift; press Delete under the cart item.
The can wiggles, then the view zooms into it and its swirling dark inside spreads across the button.
The word slides into the hole while each letter spins down, then the hole closes and the can gulps with a puff.
The card tips over and falls away, a note offers Undo; press it, or wait 6 seconds, and the item springs back.
